name: Maplayer One

beforeReset.title: Winter Countdown: don’t lose day 1
beforeReset.how: Day 1 of the check-in only lasts from maintenance to the daily reset, about 2 hours. Join and check in before the reset, then check in again after it for day 2. The window has 14 days for 15 reward tiers, so every day counts.

beforeReset.title: Ultima Supply Report: log in before and after the reset
beforeReset.how: Join Operation Ultima, log in once before the daily reset and once after it. Both days count toward this week’s 5 supply collections.

beforeReset.title: Do your symbol dailies on both sides of the reset
beforeReset.how: Arcane River and Grandis dailies reset with the day. Clear them now, then again after the reset.

beforeReset.title: Spend Bounty Coins before the shop reset
beforeReset.how: Items marked “weekly” in the Bounty Coin Shop (4x EXP Coupons, Bright Cubes, Solid Cubes and more) refresh {THU}, a few hours after maintenance. Kill your weekly bosses solo after joining Operation Ultima, buy the weekly items now, then buy them again after the reset. Other items have event-long limits and don’t refresh.

setup.title: Re-spend your Legion Points
setup.how: The Legion Revamp wiped your Legion stats. Re-allocate them before you boss or train.

setup.title: Join Operation Ultima
setup.how: Event List → Operation Ultima → Participate, then do the lightbulb quest Hard-Fought Intel. This unlocks Shadow Bounties. Lv.101+.

setup.title: Do weekly bosses after joining, solo
setup.how: Shadow Bounties only pays for solo kills, so join Operation Ultima and take the Hard-Fought Intel quest before you do your weekly bosses.

setup.title: Join Winter Countdown
setup.how: Event List → Winter Countdown → Participate. The window is short (until Nov 24), so start on day 0.

setup.title: Decide your Etherion Relic cores
setup.how: Your first Relic completion lets you pick a core. Picks can’t be undone.

setup.title: Grab free HEXA + Erda Link reset scrolls
setup.how: From Maple Administrator. Once per character, Lv.260+. They expire Dec 16, so you only need them if you plan to re-spec.

setup.title: Pick a Beyond Burning character
setup.how: One Lv.260–278 character per account (permanent): +1 extra level per level up to 280. Pick it before you level it, because levels you already passed don’t pay.

setup.title: Set up Hyper Burning MAX alt
setup.how: New character, or an existing Lv.200–258 one. Gives +4 extra levels per level up to 260. Same rule: set it up before you level. Level rewards are once per account, so use it on the character you’ll actually level.

setup.title: Challenger World: choose Heroic or Interactive
setup.how: Your first Challenger character locks this choice for the season, even if you delete it.

setup.title: Decide on a Quanah character (only at creation)
setup.how: When creating a Challenger World character, tick Quanah World Leap. It can’t be added later. That character gets Hyper Burning MAX to Lv.260, then leaps to Quanah after 6th job. It can’t use Beyond Burning, Item Burning or most events. Quanah ends Mar 9, so start early if you want one.

setup.title: Quanah prep before you leap
setup.how: Learn story-quest skills like Hero’s Echo first, because they can’t be learned in Quanah. Claim all Hyper Burning rewards and empty your Use tab. Gachapon items, Wonderberries and Star Stamps can’t come with you. Community tip (not in the notes): get an Android first.

setup.title: Pick your Item Burning Plus character
setup.how: Only one Challenger World character per account, ever. Deleting it doesn’t give you another try. It must be made after the patch, be Lv.200+ with “A Greater Power” done, and not be a Quanah character. It also can’t be in another Item Burning event.

setup.title: Pick your Sol Janus Support character
setup.how: One Lv.260+ Challenger character gets Sol Janus Lv.30 while in Challenger World. You can’t switch to another character later, even by deleting it. That character also can’t level Sol Janus itself, and the skill goes back to its old level after a World Leap.

daily.title: Log in on one character
daily.how: Gives the Ultima Supply Report reward (three 3x EXP Coupons), shared across your account, up to 5 times a week and 60 in total. Missed days from earlier weeks can be bought back for 3,000 Maple Points each.

daily.title: Winter Countdown check-in
daily.how: One check-in per day, 14 days in total. Missed days can’t be made up.

daily.title: Use Shadow Supplies charges
daily.how: Each character gets 10 charges a day and stores at most 50. Hunt near your level: 500 kills spawns an EXP box.

daily.title: Symbol dailies (Arcane / Grandis)
daily.how: Etherion Relics and Training cards add EXP and extra symbols. The extra symbols count once per character per region each day.

weekly.title: Ultima Training Report
weekly.how: 10,000 kills near your level. Click Complete at each 2,000. Shared across the account.

weekly.title: Etherion Relics energy
weekly.how: 10,000 kills solo (no party), then Collect. Unused weekly completions stack, so you can catch up later.

weekly.title: Shadow Bounties (solo bosses)
weekly.how: Solo (1-person party). Each week you get the coins of your single best boss, so killing a lower boss after a higher one adds nothing, and a higher one later pays only the difference. Caps per world: 3,000 Basic, 2,000 Intermediate, 100 Advanced.

weekly.title: Specter Blast clear
weekly.how: Lv.260+. One EXP payout per account per week. Event List → Specter Blast.

weekly.title: Luxe Sauna (optional)
weekly.how: Up to 48h of charge per week.

weekly.title: Bounty Coin Shop purchases
weekly.how: Items marked “weekly” refresh {THU}. Buy them before the reset or lose that week’s purchases. Weekly items in every world: 4x EXP Coupons (2) and Karma Bright Cubes (3 + 7). {H|Also Solid Cube x2 Coupons (6), Extreme Growth Potion x3 (3), Black Circulator x3 (2) and Karma Solid Cubes (20).}{I|Also Karma Bonus Bright Cubes (3 + 7).}

weekly.title: Challenger Pass missions
weekly.how: Lv.260+ Challenger World characters, once per account. Max 500 points a week, and Lv.30 needs 3,000, so plan on 6 full weeks.

weekly.title: Battlesim: use your Projected Weekly Power
weekly.how: 150 power a week, 1 per floor. Leftover power is wasted at the reset ({THU}). Only once your Quanah character has leaped.

dates.title: First shops & passes reset
dates.sub: Bounty Coin Shop limits, Challenger Pass and Battlesim power roll over. This is the end of the patch-day double-dip window.

dates.title: Sunny Sunday: EXP
dates.sub: 3× Treasure Hunter, Combo Kill +300%, Rune EXP, Monster Park +250%, 2× Sol Erda

dates.title: First event-weeklies reset
dates.sub: Ultima Training Report, Etherion Relics, Shadow Bounties boss records and Specter Blast start their second week.

dates.title: Sunny Sunday: Star Force
dates.sub: 30% off Star Force, 30% less boom at 21★ and below, 50% off Ability

dates.title: Sunny Sunday + free gift
dates.sub: Claim “Special Sunny Sunday Gifts for All” in the Event List that day. 1+1 Star Force up to 12★, cheap Spell Traces and Abilities.

dates.title: Sunny Sunday: Star Force + Sol Erda
dates.sub: 30% off Star Force, less boom, 2× Sol Erda

dates.title: Free HEXA / Erda Link reset scrolls expire
dates.sub: Challenger World Leap opens after maintenance

dates.title: Most events end, last day to claim
dates.sub: Operation Ultima and its shops, Challenger World, Burning events, Arthur’s Rental, New Recruit, Genesis Pass Plus

dates.title: Claimed event items expire
dates.sub: Genesis Pass Plus items last until Feb 17

dates.title: Challenger World final leap window closes
Quanah Event World ends
dates.sub: Characters get moved to the World Leap zone

cards.name: Operation Ultima
cards.what: The main event this patch. It bundles a story chapter, two weekly kill missions, a solo-boss coin shop, and EXP boxes. Most of the progress is shared across your account.
cards.tip: Do the weekly 10,000-kill missions on any one character.

cards.name: Etherion Relics
cards.what: Each week you do 10,000 solo kills to unlock a bonus: more daily-quest EXP, Monster Park EXP, Sol Erda, Epic Dungeon EXP. Bosses drop Etherion, which you use to upgrade those bonuses.
cards.tip: You choose the cores yourself, and a choice can’t be undone.

cards.name: Shadow Bounties
cards.how: Starts after the Hard-Fought Intel quest
cards.what: Solo a weekly boss (Lotus and up) for Bounty Coins, then spend them in the Bounty Coin Shop (Hawk, or Event List). Each week pays the coins of your best boss only, so one hard kill is enough.
cards.tip: Coins only work in the world where you earned them.

cards.name: Shadow Supplies
cards.how: Turns on by itself in hunting maps
cards.what: Kill 500 monsters near your level and an EXP box spawns. Break it for a big EXP chunk (one level at most).
cards.tip: Charges stop stacking at 50, so log in at least every 5 days.

cards.name: Specter Blast
cards.what: A 2-player minigame where you play as Gaon or Keira. Clear it once a week for EXP based on your level.
cards.tip: Leaving a Quick Start game early carries a penalty.

cards.name: Sunny Sundays
cards.how: Just log in that Sunday. Sundays are in UTC, which on the US west coast is Saturday 4 PM to Sunday 4 PM.
cards.what: Five Sundays of buffs: Nov 15 and Dec 13 for EXP, Nov 22 and Dec 6 for Star Force, Nov 29 for everything plus a free gift.
cards.tip: Save Star Force attempts for Nov 22, Nov 29 and Dec 6.

cards.name: Beyond Burning
cards.what: +1 extra level per level up to 280, plus milestone rewards. One character per account, permanent.
cards.tip: Levels you already passed don’t pay out, so set it up before you level.

cards.name: Luxe Sauna
cards.what: An AFK EXP room. Time costs 3,000 Maple Points an hour or comes from event coupons. Timer only runs while you’re inside.
cards.tip: Charge cap is 48h per week (resets {WED}).

cards.name: Lethe (new job)
cards.what: A Magician that summons demon vassals that chase enemies on their own. INT main stat.
cards.tip: New Recruit Support gives extra rewards to Lethe characters.

cards.name: Hyper Burning MAX + Hyper Blink
cards.what: +4 extra levels per level up to 260. Brand-new characters also get +5,000% EXP from 200 to 259.
cards.tip: Level rewards are once per account.

cards.name: Arthur’s Equipment Rental
cards.what: Rent 20★ gear, rings and totems for 2 days, up to 3 times per item per week. The first rental of each item costs mesos and repeats cost 1,000–4,000 Maple Points. {H|First rentals cost 100M–300M mesos.}{I|First rentals cost 100M–150M mesos, and the gear also comes with Unique bonus potential and bonus stats.}
cards.tip: Useful for pushing a boss you’re just short on.

cards.name: Challenger World S4
cards.what: A fresh season world. Missions earn points to climb from Bronze to Challenger tier, and the higher tiers give rewards you can claim on your main.
cards.tip: Mayrin (season boss) opens Nov 12. World Leap opens Dec 16. {H|Legendary emblem or secondary missions pay 1,500 Challenger Coins each.}{I|Legendary emblem or secondary missions pay 1,000 coins each, plus 500 for Unique bonus potential on each.}

cards.name: Event World: Quanah
cards.who: Challenger character marked for Quanah, Lv.260 + 6th job
cards.how: Mark at creation, then leap via the Event List
cards.what: A roguelite training world with a big buff (+1,000% EXP), its own gear and enhancement system, the Proving Fields and the Battlesim dungeon. Dying resets your Inspector Level to 1. The Inspector’s Mapae badge from Black Mage (Hard or Extreme) is the main reward you can take to another character.
cards.tip: Use tab must be empty to leap, no Cash Shop, no cubes or flames, no MVP perks. Libae’s Supercharged Equipment stays in Quanah; other gear transfers up to 22★. You leave to the same world type you started in.

cards.name: Genesis Pass
cards.who: Lv.255+ who haven’t finished the final Genesis awakening
cards.how: Buy in the Cash Shop, then use it from your Cash inventory
cards.what: 3× Traces of Darkness from bosses (up to 3,000), parties of up to 6 for Genesis missions from Lotus on, and a stat buff against Trace bosses. Bosses you already killed this week or month are paid out retroactively.
cards.tip: Once per account. The pass’s effects last until Feb 9.

cards.name: Genesis Pass Plus
cards.who: Genesis Pass holders past “Power Unbound, Stage 2”
cards.how: Event List → Genesis Pass Plus → Participate
cards.what: Weekly boss missions after you liberate your Genesis weapon: Black Mage first, then Seren (Dec 17), Kalos (Dec 24), First Adversary (Dec 31), Kaling (Jan 7), Bellona (Jan 14). Rewards are cubes, flames and Adversary Coins.
cards.tip: Free track for pass holders. A 30,000 NX Premium ticket adds more Adversary Coins. Practice Mode doesn’t count.

cards.name: Cash Shop Transfer
cards.what: For one week you can send cash items to a character in a different class group, such as Explorer to Cygnus Knights. Characters in the same group (same job category) can’t use this feature with each other.
cards.tip: Not allowed: Friendship Rings, Promise Rings, Potion Pots, EXP Coupons, or splitting stacks.

cards.name: Winter Countdown
cards.what: A daily check-in that pays out Winter Gifts as your check-in count goes up.
cards.tip: The window is only 14 days (Nov 11–24), so check in every day. Gifts expire Nov 25, 2:00 AM UTC.

cards.name: New Recruit Support
cards.what: Rewards for milestones: 5th job, Lv.250, 6th job, solo Chaos Vellum, solo Easy Lucid.
cards.tip: Lethe characters unlock extra rewards.

cards.name: Mayrin and Kai
cards.who: Challenger World characters: Mayrin Lv.270+ (Hard 280+), Kai Lv.235+
cards.how: Event List → Season Boss Mayrin, or Annette in town; Kai from the Boss menu
cards.what: Mayrin is the season boss: solo, weekly, once per account, 20 minutes. Drops Eternal armor fragments and boxes, pitched accessory boxes and Sol Erda Fragments. Kai is back with 90% less HP and only counts toward Challenger and Item Burning Plus missions.
cards.tip: Master tier needs a solo Normal Mayrin and Challenger tier needs a solo Hard Mayrin. Defeat Mayrin Event rewards are claimed in the Event List.

cards.name: Item Burning Plus
cards.who: Challenger World Lv.200+ characters made after the patch, after “A Greater Power”
cards.how: Event List → Item Burning Plus → Participate
cards.what: A free Challenger equipment set that upgrades through 11 stages as you hit levels, solo bosses and collect Challenge Crests. Stage 1 gives 18★ and Unique, and stage 10 reaches 21★. The last stage needs Lv.280 and a solo Normal Mayrin.
cards.tip: Once per account and not for Quanah characters. The gear expires Feb 9 and stops upgrading after a World Leap.

cards.name: Challenger extras
cards.what: Challenger Pass: weekly missions for up to 500 points, Lv.30 max, with optional 19,800 NX EXP and Premium tracks. Sol Janus Support: one Lv.260+ character gets Sol Janus Lv.30 while in Challenger World. Arcane Seal: 3 free Sealing Wands a day for stat cores. Challenger World Shop: spend Challenger Coins.
cards.tip: Sol Janus Support and Arcane Core stats go away when you World Leap.

wrapup.title: Claim Winter Gifts
wrapup.how: Event List → Winter Countdown. Then use them, because they vanish Nov 25, 2:00 AM UTC.

wrapup.title: Claim the Sunny Sunday free gift
wrapup.how: Event List → Special Sunny Sunday Gifts for All. Only on Nov 29.

wrapup.title: Claim Specter Blast cumulative rewards
wrapup.how: Event List on the left of the screen. Once per account.

wrapup.title: Use (or skip) the HEXA / Erda Link reset scrolls
wrapup.how: They expire Dec 16, 2:00 AM UTC.

wrapup.title: Do any Cash Shop transfers
wrapup.how: Cash Inventory → Cash Transfer. Only to characters in a different class group.

wrapup.title: Claim Ultima Archive and Supply Report rewards
wrapup.how: Event List → Ultima Report. Claim Records Viewed rewards (bottom-right) and Supply Report level rewards.

wrapup.title: Spend all Etherion on Relic cores
wrapup.how: Etherion can’t be used after the event. Also claim the reward for reaching combined core level 30.

wrapup.title: Spend Bounty Coins
wrapup.how: Bounty Coin Shop (Hawk or Event List), in each world you have coins. {H|Extra stock: Solid Cube x2 Coupons, Extreme Growth Potions, Black Circulators, Karma Solid Cubes.}{I|Extra stock: Bonus Bright Cubes, Incredible Chaos Scrolls, Ark Innocence Scrolls, pet and accessory scroll selectors.}

wrapup.title: Spend Alliance Credit
wrapup.how: Alliance Credit Shop (Cygnus Supplier or Ultima Report). Also has 5 Infinite Revitalizers a day and 5 Golden Strawberry Farm passes a week (Lv.101–259). {H|Extra stock: Black Rebirth Flames (10 credit each, 200 max).}{I|Extra stock: Bonus Mystical Cubes, Special Bonus and Bonus Epic Potential scrolls, Innocence and Pure Clean Slate scrolls, Special Heart scroll selector.}

wrapup.title: Check the Operation Ultima Meso Shop
wrapup.how: Elard in the Forward Operating Base. Last chance for its items.{I|Extra stock: Incredible Chaos Scrolls of Goodness and Pet Equipment Stat Transfer Scrolls.}

wrapup.title: Claim Hyper Burning MAX and Beyond Burning rewards
wrapup.how: Each event’s UI. Leaped characters can still claim in their new world.

wrapup.title: Claim New Recruit Support rewards
wrapup.how: Event List → New Recruit Missions.

wrapup.title: Claim Challenger tier rewards
wrapup.how: Bronze–Platinum only in Challenger World. Emerald and up can be claimed on your main via the Event List. {H|Tiers also give Karma Bright Cubes and Sol Erda selectors.}{I|Tiers also give Bonus Bright Cubes and a Unique Bonus Potential scroll.}

wrapup.title: Spend Challenger Coins and claim Challenger Pass levels
wrapup.how: Challenger World Shop and the Challenger Pass UI.

wrapup.title: Claim Genesis Pass Plus rewards and spend Adversary Coins
wrapup.how: Event List → Genesis Pass Plus. Items from it last until Feb 17, 2:00 AM UTC.

wrapup.title: Use claimed event items
wrapup.how: EXP coupons, cubes, flames, Sol Erda, VIP buffs and selector coupons from this patch expire Feb 10, 2:00 AM UTC.

wrapup.title: Sell or buy on the Challenger Meso Market
wrapup.how: Miss Richfield in Challenger-Interactive. Closes before maintenance on Feb 10.

wrapup.title: World Leap your Challenger characters
wrapup.how: Leap opens Dec 16. The final window is Feb 10–23.

wrapup.title: Claim “A Gift for the Future” on your Quanah character
wrapup.how: Event List once it reaches Lv.200 in Challenger World. Claim all Hyper Burning rewards before leaping, and empty your Use tab.

wrapup.title: Finish your Inspector’s Mapae before leaving Quanah
wrapup.how: It can’t be upgraded after the leap (Interactive worlds can still use bonus potential and scrolls). Max its Star Force (22★) and roll potential for the stat of the character you’ll give it to. It can be moved once within your account.

wrapup.title: Finish Quanah and use its Maple Point items
wrapup.how: MP shop closes Mar 8 and its items stop working Mar 9. Characters get moved to the leap zone automatically.

wrapup.title: Use up Luxe Sauna time and claim hour rewards
wrapup.how: Unused time is lost. Furnishing rewards at 30/100/200/500 cumulative hours.

decisions.title: Should I do Quanah?
decisions.intro: Quanah is a limited-time event world that closes for everyone on Mar 9. Only a Challenger World character with “Quanah World Leap” ticked at creation can go, after Lv.260 and 6th job. Treat it as a second main for the next four months, not a side alt.

time.q: Can you play a second character like a second main until Mar 9?
time.help: The notes don’t give hours, but here’s what it involves: level a brand-new character to 260 and finish 6th job, prep before leaping, then a farming-heavy world where your Inspector Level drops back to 1 every time you die, boss entries come from farming, and Battlesim allows 150 floors a week. The badge drops from Black Mage (Hard or Extreme), so you need a strong Quanah character. All of this is on top of your main’s weeklies.

options.label: Yes, I have that kind of time

want.q: What would you get out of it?
want.help: Pick the one that matters most to you.

options.label: The Inspector’s Mapae badge for my main
options.note: Drops from Black Mage (Hard or Extreme) in Quanah. Its attack grows with Star Force, up to 22★. It can be moved once to another character on your account after you leave, but can’t be upgraded after that. Community estimates put it around +92 ATT when maxed (not stated in the notes).

options.label: An extra Lv.260+ character from March
options.note: It leaps into a world of the same type as its Challenger World (Heroic or Interactive). Libae’s Supercharged Equipment stays behind; other gear transfers up to 22★.

options.label: The gameplay itself
options.note: +1,000% EXP buff, Battlesim roguelite dungeon, Proving Fields, its own gear system.

hbm.q: Were you going to use Hyper Burning MAX on a different alt this patch?
hbm.help: Hyper Burning MAX level-up rewards can only be claimed once per account, and a Quanah character levels with Hyper Burning MAX.

options.label: My other alt’s Hyper Burning rewards

skip-time.title: Skip Quanah
skip-time.text: Quanah is closer to a second main than a side alt. Without that time, it isn’t worth it, and your main’s Operation Ultima weeklies, Shadow Bounties and Sunny Sundays don’t depend on it.
points: Spend the time on your main’s weekly 10,000-kill missions and solo bosses.
You can still use Hyper Burning MAX on a normal alt.

skip-value.title: Skip Quanah
skip-value.text: If you don’t want the badge, the extra character or the game mode, there’s nothing else in it for you. Skipping costs you nothing on your main.
points: Keep your Hyper Burning MAX rewards for a normal alt if you want one.

skip-hbm.title: Skip Quanah, use Hyper Burning MAX on your alt
skip-hbm.text: Hyper Burning MAX level rewards are once per account, so spending them on your planned alt is the better fit.
points: Set the alt up as Hyper Burning MAX before you level it.
Brand-new characters also get Hyper Blink (+5,000% EXP from 200 to 259).

do.title: Do Quanah
do.text: You have the time, you can start soon, you want what it gives, and nothing else is competing for your Hyper Burning MAX rewards. Expect it to take most of the next four months.
steps: Create a Challenger World character of the same type as your main (Challenger-Heroic for a Heroic main) and tick Quanah World Leap.
Level it with Hyper Burning MAX. At Lv.200, claim A Gift for the Future in the Event List (the notes don’t list what it contains).
Before leaping: learn story-quest skills like Hero’s Echo (they can’t be learned in Quanah), claim all Hyper Burning rewards, and empty your Use tab. You get 5,000 Elixirs on arrival.
Community tip (not in the notes): get an Android before you leap.
Leap with Event List → Invitation to Another Dimension, and do the tutorial for 2,000 Quanah Crystals.
Farm toward Black Mage (Hard or Extreme) for the Inspector’s Mapae.
Before you leave Quanah, finish the Mapae’s Star Force and roll its potential for the stat of the character you’ll give it to. It can’t be upgraded after the leap.

do-hbm.title: Do Quanah, skip the other alt’s Hyper Burning
do-hbm.text: The Quanah character uses your account’s Hyper Burning MAX level rewards, so your other alt levels without them.
steps: Create a Challenger World character of the same type as your main and tick Quanah World Leap.
Level it with Hyper Burning MAX and claim A Gift for the Future at Lv.200.
Before leaping: learn story-quest skills like Hero’s Echo (they can’t be learned in Quanah), claim all Hyper Burning rewards, and empty your Use tab. You get 5,000 Elixirs on arrival.
Community tip (not in the notes): get an Android before you leap.
Leap, then farm toward Black Mage (Hard or Extreme) for the Mapae badge.
Before you leave Quanah, finish the Mapae’s Star Force and roll its potential for the stat of the character you’ll give it to. It can’t be upgraded after the leap.

middle.title: Keep the option open
middle.text: The only thing you can’t add later is the Quanah tick at character creation. Make the character now and decide around Lv.260.
steps: Create a Challenger World character of your main’s type and tick Quanah World Leap. It uses one of your 5 Challenger slots.
Level it with Hyper Burning MAX.
Think before claiming its Hyper Burning level rewards, since they’re once per account.
Decide by around Lv.260. Starting Quanah late leaves less time before Mar 9.

start.q: Could you start levelling it within the next couple of weeks?
start.help: Quanah closes on Mar 9 no matter when you arrive. Every week spent levelling or prepping is a week less inside Quanah.

late.title: Only if the badge is worth a rush
late.text: Starting late leaves much less time inside Quanah before it closes on Mar 9, and Battlesim is capped at 150 floors a week, so you can’t fully catch up by playing more in one week. If the Mapae badge isn’t a must-have, skipping is reasonable.
points: If you still want it, tick Quanah World Leap when you create the character so the option stays open.
The 1st Quanah World Leap opens after v.273; everyone is moved out on Mar 9.
